statement: The five surviving zero-rigid spectral research routes in the repository — (1) Radial-Defect Quotient (RDQ: Tr R = sum delta^2 / gamma^2), (2) Curvature Transport (B_rho''(0) / (2 (log tau)^2) = delta^2), (3) Pointwise Weil-Hermitian Involution Defect (2 delta^2 / (|rho|^2 |1-rho|^2)), (4) Completed Mean-Square Anchor (CMSA: Delta Z_sigma resolvent response), and (5) Fibre Sesquilinear Form (M_K''(0) = 2 N_gamma sum delta^2) — are mutually isomorphic spectral representations of zero-rigidity (sum w_j delta_j^2 = 0 <=> all delta_j = 0). None of them provide the independent arithmetic evaluation A_{arith} = 0. They consolidate into exactly ONE genuinely distinct viable radial descent path (ONE_VIABLE_RADIAL_DESCENT_BRANCH_REMAINS) governed by the single shared Master Obligation OBL-RADIAL-DEFECT-DESCENT.
